veranderings.blok: Wat beeste vir die boere gegee het
veranderings.voor: beeste aangehou wat hulle op baie maniere gehelp het
veranderings.na: beeste aangehou, en die beeste het hulle op baie maniere gehelp
veranderings.rede: With 'wat hulle' a young reader can briefly take 'wat' as object (the farmers helped the cattle); naming the subject removes the ambiguity, and the AWS comma is required between the two clauses.

veranderings.blok: Wat beeste vir die boere gegee het
veranderings.rede: In Afrikaans the adjunct naturally stands before the past participle at the end of the clause; 'geslag vir hulle vleis' follows English order.

veranderings.voor: Ons sê so 'n gesin het hoë status gehad
veranderings.na: Ons sê dat so 'n gesin hoë status gehad het
veranderings.rede: Written study text reads better with the full 'dat' clause and verb-final order than with the spoken form without 'dat'.

veranderings.na: hoeveel respek ander mense vir hom het
veranderings.rede: 'hoeveel ander mense' reads as a count of people, while the definition means the degree of respect; the new wording keeps that meaning unambiguous.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: Protected in the sense 'man or woman' (not 'gender'), but in this lesson it appears only as the verb 'slaughtered' ('beeste ... geslag'); no change to it is proposed, and the word stays intact in the word-order change, but the entry does not really apply to this lesson.
